title: 5d brainstorm: constraint system + DD design
description:
Brainstorm the constraint system and differential dataflow integration using vidhi-brainstorm. Key areas:

- DD scope — what lives in DD maintained views vs what stays as ad-hoc queries? Current spike covers cycles, blast radius, forbidden deps. What else benefits from incrementalization?
- Constraint authoring — how architects express rules. Current rules.toml format, evolution toward richer constraint language. Datalog-like view definitions?
- Boundary enforcement — component boundaries (from 5b) as first-class constraints. "Module X must not import from module Y" as a live DD view.
- ADRs as live constraints — parsing architectural decision records, extracting checkable constraints, making decisions self-enforcing
- Real-time constraint checking — DD's incremental update from Layer 0 deltas during active development. Latency requirements, what can be real-time vs on-save vs on-review
- How the current DD engine evolves — the spike validated viability with caveats. What were the caveats? Memory model, startup cost, serialization.
- Interaction with trust model — constraint violations as blocking vs advisory, waiver mechanics
- The module rename (dd/ → constraints/) — when and how
- Independence from 5c — constraints and conventions are parallel tracks, how do they stay decoupled?

Input: docs/sutra-vision.md (L3 section), current DD engine code, spike results, 5a decisions
Output: shared understanding ready for PRD
decisions: DD scope: maintained views for cycles, blast radius, forbidden deps, boundary enforcement, transitive reachability. Ad-hoc for PageRank, co-change, one-shot queries. Component-level aggregations deferred.

Constraint authoring: hybrid — well-typed structured TOML patterns for common kinds (forbidden_dep, boundary, max_fan_in, no_cycles), future Datalog escape hatch. Per-instance severity, optional provenance field.

Boundary enforcement: DD operates on file IDs only. Boundary constraints resolved to file-level forbidden pairs via component_membership join. Resolution triggers on both edge changes and component recomputation.
ADRs as live constraints: not auto-parsed. Workflow is human+agent writes constraint alongside ADR, provenance field links them. Human-supervised authoring.
Latency tiers: on-save (<100ms), on-review (seconds OK), on-hook (<2s). No on-keystroke.

DD engine: add second input collection for forbidden pairs (maintained view). Richer violation output with constraint_kind, severity, provenance. Memory-only state, DB is source of truth, no persistence of DD graph.
Trust model: per-instance severity on constraints. Constraint waivers as durable table (same pattern as convention_waivers). Sketch mode: constraints remain enforced per ADR-0001.
Module rename: dd/ → constraints/ as first PR of 5d implementation.
5c/5d independence: clean — share review pipeline, rules file, guard, orient, DB infrastructure. No data dependency between convention and constraint tables.
execution_record: Brainstorm session. Read vision doc (L3 constraints section), architecture doc, core model PRD (5a), DD spike results (spike/hdc-ast-encoding branch), current DD engine code (src/dd/), rules.rs format, conventions-map.md for 5c state. Worked through all 9 brainstorm areas. Output: docs/brainstorm-constraints.md with consolidated decisions ready for PRD.
